reference.portability: Other hardware is reported separately; no desktop or cross-platform certification from a Node benchmark.

measurement.memory: process.resourceUsage.maxRSS; process peak, not per-operation allocation

release.tokenEstimate: ceil(UTF-8 bytes / 4), heuristic only; measured provider usage remains separate
release.monetaryPolicy: Unknown until comparable prices and units are available. Subscription quota is not a monetary price; no automatic paid escalation.

correctness.economyEligibility: At least 10% fewer input bytes on identical fixtures with all mandatory scenarios and constraints preserved. Byte savings alone never qualify a model or compiler.

changePolicy: Never tune thresholds after a failing acceptance run. A new version records rationale and reruns both baseline and candidate; retain the old report. These are acceptance targets, not current runtime enforcement.
